subtitle: Constitutional Deadlock and Preference-Free Neutral Tiebreak Extension

new_primitives.DEADLOCK_CASE_ID: Identifier for a case with mutually exclusive admissible actions and harmful delay.
new_primitives.ACTION_EQUIVALENCE_CLASS_ID: Deduplicated action candidate identity independent of face count.
new_primitives.NEUTRAL_TIEBREAK_PROFILE_ID: Precommitted rule for choosing among otherwise constitutionally indistinguishable action classes.
new_primitives.NEUTRAL_TIEBREAK_RECEIPT: Replayable record binding candidates, selector/entropy provenance, rule version and selected action class.

core_rule: When delay is harmful and constitutional criteria distinguish no winner, the sovereign may invoke only a precommitted preference-free tiebreak over unique action classes; it may not choose a favorite face.
priority_order: apply dominance rules such as lower unnecessary irreversible loss where explicitly defined
if true symmetry remains and action is required, invoke neutral tiebreak
commit selected action under normal authority
do not elevate the associated face to future priority
anti_sybil_rule: Faces and duplicate proposals are deduplicated into action-equivalence classes before neutral selection.
verification_requirements: reversibility-dominance deadlock resolves without face preference
duplicate faces cannot increase action probability
selector chosen after outcome is known is rejected
winning action does not grant persistent priority to originating face
canonical_lines: A neutral judge may choose an action without choosing a superior identity.
Deadlock resolution is legitimate only when the method existed before the desired winner was known.
The lottery, where needed, is over actions—not over how many masks demand them.
